source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 6: The Present Perfect Tense

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ. Tìm vị trí lỗi, không chỉ chọn đáp án.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ, không liên quan đến field khác

starter.stem: She ___ worked at this tech company for five years.
starter.explanation_short: She = ngôi 3 số ít → has + V3.
starter.explanation_long: Present Perfect ngôi 3 số ít dùng 'has' + past participle. 'Have' chỉ dùng cho I/you/we/they.
starter.feedback_wrong: She = ngôi 3 số ít → has (không phải have)
starter.ielts_tip: He/She/It + has + V3. I/You/We/They + have + V3.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: have (wrong agreement), had (past perfect), is (continuous)

starter.stem: I have ___ two emails to my manager this morning.
starter.explanation_long: Present Perfect: have/has + past participle. Write là bất quy tắc: write → wrote (V2) → written (V3). 'Wrote' là Simple Past.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 write → wrote → written. Sau have dùng V3!
starter.feedback_wrong: write → wrote (V2) → written (V3). Sau have phải dùng V3: written.
starter.ielts_tip: Nhớ V3 bất quy tắc: write-wrote-written, take-took-taken, give-gave-given.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: wrote (V2), writed (không tồn tại), writing (V-ing)

starter.explanation_short: 2020 = mốc thời gian cụ thể → since.
starter.explanation_long: 'Since' dùng với mốc thời gian cụ thể (since 2020, since Monday). 'For' dùng với khoảng thời gian (for 3 years).
starter.feedback_wrong: 2020 = mốc thời gian cụ thể → since. Nếu là '3 years' thì dùng for.
starter.ielts_tip: since + mốc (since 2020, since last year). for + khoảng (for 5 years, for a long time).
starter.distractor_note: obvious: for (khoảng thời gian), from (không đi với Present Perfect), during (sai ngữ pháp)

starter.stem: The IT team has ___ fixed the server issue.
starter.explanation_short: Câu khẳng định + đã xong → already (đặt giữa has và V3).
starter.explanation_long: 'Already' dùng trong câu khẳng định, đặt giữa has/have và V3. 'Yet' chỉ dùng trong câu phủ định/câu hỏi.
starter.feedback_correct: 🎯 Câu khẳng định → already. Đặt giữa has/have và V3.
starter.feedback_wrong: Câu khẳng định → already (không phải yet). Yet chỉ dùng trong phủ định/câu hỏi.
starter.ielts_tip: already = câu khẳng định (has already done). yet = câu hỏi/phủ định (hasn't done yet).
starter.distractor_note: obvious: yet (phủ định/hỏi), since (mốc thời gian), ago (Simple Past)

starter.stem: We ___ a new project management tool last month.
starter.explanation_short: last month = thời gian cụ thể trong quá khứ → Simple Past: adopted.
starter.explanation_long: 'Last month' là mốc thời gian quá khứ xác định → dùng Simple Past, không dùng Present Perfect.
starter.feedback_wrong: last month = quá khứ xác định → Simple Past: adopted. Không dùng have adopted.
starter.ielts_tip: last week/month/year, yesterday, in 2020 → Simple Past. Không dùng Present Perfect.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: have adopted (sai vì có last month), has adopted (sai ngôi + sai thì), adopt (thiếu chia)

starter.stem: ___ you ever ___ with AI tools at work?
starter.explanation_short: ever = kinh nghiệm từ trước đến nay → Have you ever + V3.
starter.explanation_long: Hỏi về kinh nghiệm (ever) dùng Present Perfect: Have you ever + V3. 'Did you ever work' sai vì hỏi kinh nghiệm chung, không hỏi thời điểm cụ thể.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 Kinh nghiệm + ever → Have you ever worked?
starter.feedback_wrong: Hỏi kinh nghiệm dùng Present Perfect: Have you ever worked?
starter.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 1: Have you ever used/tried/visited...? → Present Perfect.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: Did/work (Simple Past), Do/work (Simple Present), Are/working (Continuous)

starter.stem: He has been a software developer ___ ten years.
starter.explanation_short: ten years = khoảng thời gian → for.
starter.explanation_long: 'For' dùng với khoảng thời gian (for ten years, for a long time). 'Since' dùng với mốc cụ thể (since 2015).
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ ten years = khoảng thời gian → for
starter.feedback_wrong: ten years = khoảng thời gian → for. Nếu 2015 thì dùng since.
starter.ielts_tip: for + khoảng: for 3 months, for a decade. since + mốc: since January, since I was young.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: since (mốc), from (sai cấu trúc), in (sai giới từ)

starter.stem: The company has ___ new offices in three cities.
starter.explanation_long: Present Perfect: has + past participle. Open là động từ quy tắc: open → opened (V2=V3).
starter.feedback_wrong: Sau has phải là V3: opened. Không dùng V nguyên mẫu hay V-ing.
starter.ielts_tip: has/have + V3. Động từ quy tắc: V3 = V2 (thêm -ed). Bất quy tắc: phải nhớ.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: open (V nguyên mẫu), opening (V-ing), opens (Simple Present)

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Have you finished the report already?'
options: Sai: already → yet (câu hỏi phải dùng yet)
Đúng: already dùng được trong câu hỏi khi ngạc nhiên
starter.correct_answer: Đúng: already dùng được trong câu hỏi khi ngạc nhiên
starter.explanation_short: Already có thể dùng trong câu hỏi khi thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên.
starter.explanation_long: 'Already' trong câu hỏi diễn tả sự ngạc nhiên: 'Have you finished already?' = 'Bạn xong rồi á?' Đây không phải lỗi.
starter.feedback_correct: 🎯 already trong câu hỏi = ngạc nhiên. Không phải lỗi!
starter.feedback_wrong: already trong câu hỏi = sự ngạc nhiên. Câu này ĐÚNG.
starter.ielts_tip: already trong câu hỏi = surprise. yet trong câu hỏi = neutral question.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: option A là bẫy chính vì nhiều người nghĩ câu hỏi luôn dùng yet

starter.explanation_short: this decade = khoảng thời gian chưa kết thúc → Present Perfect.
starter.explanation_long: 'This decade' là khoảng thời gian chưa kết thúc → dùng Present Perfect: has advanced.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ this decade = chưa kết thúc → has advanced
starter.feedback_wrong: this decade = thời gian chưa kết thúc → Present Perfect: has advanced.
starter.ielts_tip: this week/month/year/decade + Present Perfect vì thời gian chưa kết thúc.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: advanced (Simple Past), is advancing (Continuous), advances (Simple Present)

build_up.stem: The startup ___ three rounds of funding and is now planning to expand globally.
build_up.explanation_short: Kết quả quá khứ vẫn còn liên quan đến hiện tại (is now planning) → Present Perfect.
build_up.explanation_long: Hành động quá khứ có kết quả ảnh hưởng đến hiện tại (is now planning to expand) → Present Perfect: has raised.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Kết quả quá khứ → hiện tại vẫn relevant → has raised
build_up.feedback_wrong: Kết quả quá khứ liên quan hiện tại → Present Perfect: has raised.
build_up.ielts_tip: Task 2: Khi nêu kết quả dẫn đến tình trạng hiện tại → dùng Present Perfect.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: raised (Simple Past cũng gần đúng nhưng thiếu liên kết hiện tại)

build_up.stem: Remote work has become increasingly popular ___ the pandemic began in 2020.
build_up.explanation_short: the pandemic began = sự kiện cụ thể → since.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Since' dùng với mốc thời gian hoặc sự kiện cụ thể: since the pandemic began. 'For' chỉ dùng với khoảng thời gian.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ since + sự kiện cụ thể: since the pandemic began
build_up.feedback_wrong: since + mốc sự kiện: since the pandemic began. Không dùng for với sự kiện.
build_up.ielts_tip: since + mệnh đề/mốc: since I graduated, since 2020. for + khoảng: for 3 years.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: when (gần đúng nhưng sai cấu trúc Present Perfect), during (sai)

build_up.stem: Several multinational companies have ___ their headquarters to Southeast Asia in recent years.
build_up.explanation_short: have + V3: move → moved. 'In recent years' → Present Perfect.
build_up.explanation_long: 'In recent years' = khoảng thời gian chưa kết thúc → Present Perfect. have + moved (V3).
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 in recent years → Present Perfect: have moved
build_up.feedback_wrong: have + V3: moved. 'In recent years' → Present Perfect.
build_up.ielts_tip: in recent years/decades → Present Perfect. Dấu hiệu quan trọng trong Task 1 và Task 2.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The company has launched its first product in 2018.'
options: has launched → launched (in 2018 = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past)
build_up.correct_answer: has launched → launched (in 2018 = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past)
build_up.explanation_short: in 2018 = mốc thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past: launched.
build_up.explanation_long: 'In 2018' là thời điểm quá khứ cụ thể → không dùng Present Perfect. Phải dùng Simple Past: launched.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 in 2018 = quá khứ cụ thể → launched (Simple Past)
build_up.feedback_wrong: in 2018 = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past: launched. Không dùng has launched.
build_up.ielts_tip: in + năm cụ thể → Simple Past. Lỗi phổ biến band 5.0 khi viết Task 1.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option D (in→since) là bẫy vì thay đổi nghĩa câu

build_up.stem: This is the most innovative product that our team ___.
build_up.explanation_short: the most + ever → so sánh nhất + kinh nghiệm → Present Perfect.
build_up.explanation_long: 'This is the most... that... has ever V3' là cấu trúc chuẩn. Superlative + ever → Present Perfect.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ the most + ever → Present Perfect: has ever developed
build_up.feedback_wrong: Superlative + ever → Present Perfect: has ever developed.
build_up.ielts_tip: This is the best/worst/most... I have ever + V3 → cấu trúc hay dùng trong Speaking.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Each employee have received a new laptop for remote work.'
build_up.explanation_long: 'Each' luôn đi với động từ số ít: Each employee has received. 'Have' sai vì 'each' = singular.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Each = singular → has. Không dùng have!
build_up.feedback_wrong: Each employee = singular → has received (không phải have received).
build_up.ielts_tip: Each/Every + noun + has. Không bao giờ dùng have sau each/every.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option B bẫy vì câu nghe tự nhiên

build_up.stem: Artificial intelligence ___ nearly every industry so far.
build_up.explanation_short: so far = cho đến nay → Present Perfect: has transformed.
build_up.explanation_long: 'So far' = cho đến thời điểm hiện tại → Present Perfect. Hành động bắt đầu trong quá khứ, kết quả vẫn liên quan.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ so far → Present Perfect: has transformed
build_up.feedback_wrong: so far = đến nay → Present Perfect: has transformed.
build_up.ielts_tip: so far, up to now, until now → Present Perfect. Dấu hiệu rõ ràng.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: is transforming (Continuous cũng gần đúng nhưng so far → Perfect)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The team hasn't completed already the final report.'
options: already → yet (phủ định dùng yet, đặt cuối câu)
build_up.correct_answer: already → yet (phủ định dùng yet, đặt cuối câu)
build_up.explanation_short: Câu phủ định dùng yet, đặt cuối câu: hasn't completed the final report yet.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Already' dùng trong câu khẳng định. Câu phủ định dùng 'yet' và đặt cuối câu: hasn't completed yet.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 Phủ định → yet (cuối câu): hasn't completed ... yet
build_up.feedback_wrong: Phủ định → yet (cuối câu). Khẳng định → already (giữa has và V3).
build_up.ielts_tip: Khẳng định: has already done. Phủ định: hasn't done yet. Câu hỏi: Has ... yet?
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option B bẫy vì already nghe quen thuộc

build_up.stem: Cloud computing ___ the way businesses operate, and it continues to evolve.
build_up.explanation_short: Kết quả quá khứ + 'continues to evolve' (vẫn tiếp diễn) → Present Perfect.
build_up.explanation_long: Hành động quá khứ có kết quả hiện tại (continues to evolve) → Present Perfect: has changed.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Quá khứ → vẫn liên quan hiện tại → has changed
build_up.feedback_wrong: Kết quả vẫn liên quan hiện tại (continues to evolve) → Present Perfect: has changed.
build_up.ielts_tip: Khi câu sau mô tả tình trạng hiện tại → câu trước dùng Present Perfect.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: changed (Simple Past), had changed (Past Perfect)

build_up.stem: The number of remote workers has increased significantly ___ the last five years.
build_up.explanation_short: over the last five years = trong suốt 5 năm qua → over.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Over the last/past + khoảng thời gian' là cách diễn đạt chuẩn trong IELTS. 'For' cũng đúng nhưng 'over' tự nhiên hơn với 'the last five years'.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ over the last five years = cách diễn đạt chuẩn IELTS
build_up.feedback_wrong: over the last/past + khoảng thời gian. Cách viết chuẩn trong Task 1/2.
build_up.ielts_tip: Task 1: 'Over the last decade, the number has increased...' → cấu trúc mô tả xu hướng.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: for (đúng ngữ pháp nhưng không tự nhiên với 'the last'), since (sai)

layers: Present Perfect vs Simple Past with time markers
challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Many tech companies have relocated to Vietnam in 2023, which have created thousands of new jobs.'
challenge.explanation_short: in 2023 = mốc cụ thể → không dùng Present Perfect. Phải sửa: relocated... in 2023 (Simple Past).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'in 2023' = thời điểm cụ thể → Simple Past, không dùng Present Perfect 'have relocated'. Lớp 2: 'which have created' — which thay cho 'companies' (số nhiều) → have đúng. Lỗi chính: 'have relocated... in 2023' → phải sửa thành 'relocated... in 2023'.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 in 2023 = thời điểm cụ thể → không dùng have relocated!
challenge.feedback_wrong: in 2023 = quá khứ cụ thể → Simple Past: relocated. Present Perfect + in 2023 = sai.
challenge.ielts_tip: Lỗi band 5.0 phổ biến: dùng Present Perfect với in + năm cụ thể.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (which have) bẫy vì tưởng which = singular nhưng which = companies

layers: Present Perfect for result still relevant
challenge.stem: Câu kết bài Task 2 nào CHUẨN NHẤT về ngữ pháp?
options: In conclusion, technology transformed the workplace and will continue to do so.
In conclusion, technology has transformed the workplace and will continue to do so.
In conclusion, technology had transformed the workplace and will continue to do so.
In conclusion, technology is transforming the workplace and will continue to do so.
challenge.correct_answer: In conclusion, technology has transformed the workplace and will continue to do so.
challenge.explanation_short: has transformed = kết quả quá khứ vẫn relevant + will continue = tương lai → Present Perfect chuẩn nhất.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'has transformed' = kết quả vẫn ảnh hưởng đến hiện tại. Lớp 2: 'will continue' = tương lai → cần liên kết quá khứ-hiện tại-tương lai. Present Perfect là cầu nối tốt nhất. 'Transformed' (Simple Past) nghe xong rồi, không liên kết hiện tại.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 has transformed + will continue = liên kết quá khứ→hiện tại→tương lai!
challenge.feedback_wrong: has transformed (vẫn relevant) + will continue = chuẩn nhất. transformed (Simple Past) = đã xong.
challenge.ielts_tip: Câu kết Task 2: has + V3 + and will continue to... → cấu trúc kết bài band 6.0+.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (transformed) gần đúng nhưng thiếu liên kết hiện tại

layers: Present Perfect Continuous vs Present Perfect
challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The IT department have been upgrading the system since three weeks, and it still hasn't been completed.'
options: The IT department have been upgrading
challenge.explanation_short: three weeks = khoảng thời gian → for, không phải since.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'since three weeks' → 'three weeks' = khoảng thời gian → phải dùng 'for three weeks'. Lớp 2: 'The IT department have' — department = singular → 'has been upgrading' (cũng sai nhưng option B sai rõ hơn). Option B là lỗi chính.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 three weeks = khoảng thời gian → for, không phải since!
challenge.feedback_wrong: three weeks = khoảng thời gian → for three weeks. since chỉ dùng với mốc cụ thể.
challenge.ielts_tip: since + mốc (since Monday). for + khoảng (for three weeks). Lỗi phổ biến nhất band 5.0–5.5.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (have → has) cũng có lỗi nhưng option B rõ ràng hơn

layers: Present Perfect for experience vs Simple Past for specific event
challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT cho IELTS Writing Task 2:
options: Many developing countries already adopted renewable energy technologies.
Many developing countries have already adopted renewable energy technologies.
Many developing countries have already adopt renewable energy technologies.
Many developing countries has already adopted renewable energy technologies.
challenge.correct_answer: Many developing countries have already adopted renewable energy technologies.
challenge.explanation_short: Many countries = plural → have + already + V3 (adopted).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Many countries' = số nhiều → have (không has). Lớp 2: already đặt giữa have và V3 = đúng. Lớp 3: adopted = V3 đúng (không phải adopt).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 have already adopted = chuẩn Present Perfect!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Many countries = plural → have. already giữa have và V3. adopted = V3.
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2: Many countries have already + V3... → cấu trúc hay dùng để nêu xu hướng.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A thiếu have, option C dùng adopt (V1), option D sai has

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN cho IELTS Writing?
'Researchers have ___ [A] that automation ___ [B] millions of jobs worldwide.'
challenge.explanation_short: have + V3: show → shown. automation = singular → has affected.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'have shown' = V3 đúng (show-showed-shown, bất quy tắc). Lớp 2: 'automation' = singular → 'has affected'. Cả hai vế đều dùng Present Perfect đúng.
challenge.feedback_wrong: show → showed (V2) → shown (V3). Sau have dùng shown. automation → has.
challenge.ielts_tip: Task 2: Researchers have shown/demonstrated/found that... → V3 bất quy tắc phổ biến.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (shown/affected) gần đúng nhưng thiếu has

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Since smartphones have become affordable, people communicated more efficiently than ever before.'
challenge.explanation_short: Since + Present Perfect → mệnh đề chính cũng dùng Present Perfect: have communicated.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Since' + Present Perfect (have become) → mệnh đề chính phải dùng Present Perfect: 'have communicated'. 'Communicated' (Simple Past) sai vì since ngụ ý hành động kéo dài đến hiện tại.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 Since + have become → mệnh đề chính: have communicated!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Since + Present Perfect → mệnh đề chính cũng Present Perfect: have communicated.
challenge.ielts_tip: Since + S + V (Past/Present Perfect), S + have/has + V3. Cả hai mệnh đề phải nhất quán.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A trông có vẻ sai nhưng since + have become = đúng

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Over the past decade, digital technology reshaped the global workforce significantly.
Over the past decade, digital technology has reshaped the global workforce significantly.
Over the past decade, digital technology reshapes the global workforce significantly.
Over the past decade, digital technology had reshaped the global workforce significantly.
challenge.correct_answer: Over the past decade, digital technology has reshaped the global workforce significantly.
challenge.explanation_short: Over the past decade = thời gian chưa kết thúc → Present Perfect: has reshaped.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Over the past decade' = khoảng thời gian kéo dài đến hiện tại → Present Perfect. Lớp 2: 'has reshaped' chuẩn hơn 'reshaped' (Simple Past) trong ngữ cảnh học thuật mô tả xu hướng.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Over the past decade + has reshaped = chuẩn Task 2!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Over the past decade = chưa kết thúc → Present Perfect: has reshaped.
challenge.ielts_tip: Over the past/last + period → Present Perfect. Cấu trúc phổ biến nhất trong Task 1.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (reshaped) gần đúng nhưng kém chính xác với 'over the past'

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The number of employees who has completed the training program have increased by 40% this quarter.'
challenge.explanation_short: who thay cho employees (số nhiều) → have completed, không phải has completed.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'who' thay cho 'employees' (số nhiều) → 'who have completed'. Lớp 2: 'The number of... have increased' — 'The number of' = singular → 'has increased' (cũng sai). Nhưng option B sai rõ ràng nhất.
challenge.feedback_wrong: who thay cho employees (plural) → who have completed. Và: The number of → has increased.
challenge.ielts_tip: who thay cho danh từ số nhiều → who have. The number of + singular verb.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (have → has increased) cũng có lỗi — câu này có 2 lỗi

challenge.stem: Chọn cặp câu ĐÚNG NHẤT về ngữ pháp trong body paragraph Task 2:
options: Several companies adopted AI last year. This trend continued to grow.
Several companies have adopted AI in recent years. This trend has continued to grow.
Several companies adopted AI in recent years. This trend continued to grow.
Several companies have adopted AI last year. This trend has continued to grow.
challenge.correct_answer: Several companies have adopted AI in recent years. This trend has continued to grow.
challenge.explanation_short: in recent years = chưa kết thúc → Present Perfect. This trend has continued = vẫn đang diễn ra.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'in recent years' → Present Perfect (have adopted). Lớp 2: 'This trend has continued' → vẫn đang tiếp tục. Lớp 3: Option D sai vì 'last year' + Present Perfect.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 in recent years + has continued = nhất quán Present Perfect!
challenge.feedback_wrong: in recent years → Present Perfect. last year → Simple Past. Không trộn lẫn.
challenge.ielts_tip: Body Task 2: in recent years/decades → Present Perfect xuyên suốt đoạn văn.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A đúng ngữ pháp nhưng kém academic; option D sai (last year + have adopted)

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'The government have [A] took significant steps to promote digital literacy, which [B] has lead to a noticeable improvement in [C] workforce productivity.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] have took → has taken (government = singular + V3). [B] has lead → has led (lead-led-led).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'The government have took' → government = singular → 'has' + took → taken (take-took-taken) = 'has taken'. Lớp 2: [B] 'has lead' → lead bất quy tắc: lead-led-led → 'has led'. Lớp 3: [C] 'workforce productivity' = đúng, không có lỗi.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] has taken | [B] has led | [C] đúng!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] government = singular → has + taken (V3). [B] lead → led (V3). [C] đúng.
challenge.ielts_tip: V3 hay sai: take→taken, lead→led, give→given, write→written. Kiểm tra kỹ V3 khi review.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C bẫy vì tưởng 'workforce productivity' sai. Option A bỏ sót lỗi [B].

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Starter
ui.description: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

items.stem: She ___ worked at this tech company for five years.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ Đúng! She → has worked
items.feedback_wrong: She = ngôi 3 số ít → has (không phải have)
items.explanation_short: She = ngôi 3 số ít → has + V3.
items.ielts_tip: He/She/It + has + V3. I/You/We/They + have + V3.

items.stem: I have ___ two emails to my manager this morning.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 write → wrote → written. Sau have dùng V3!
items.feedback_wrong: write → wrote (V2) → written (V3). Sau have phải dùng V3: written.
items.explanation_short: have + V3: write → wrote → written.
items.ielts_tip: Nhớ V3 bất quy tắc: write-wrote-written, take-took-taken.

items.stem: They have used this software ___ 2020.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ 2020 = mốc thời gian → since
items.feedback_wrong: 2020 = mốc thời gian cụ thể → since.
items.explanation_short: 2020 = mốc thời gian cụ thể → since.
items.ielts_tip: since + mốc. for + khoảng.

items.stem: The IT team has ___ fixed the server issue.
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 Câu khẳng định → already
items.feedback_wrong: Câu khẳng định → already. yet chỉ dùng trong phủ định/câu hỏi.
items.explanation_short: Câu khẳng định + đã xong → already.
items.ielts_tip: already = khẳng định. yet = phủ định/hỏi.

items.stem: We ___ a new project management tool last month.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ last month → Simple Past: adopted
items.feedback_wrong: last month = quá khứ cụ thể → Simple Past: adopted.
items.explanation_short: last month = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past.
items.ielts_tip: last week/month/year → Simple Past, không dùng Present Perfect.

items.stem: ___ you ever ___ with AI tools at work?
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Kinh nghiệm + ever → Have you ever worked?
items.feedback_wrong: Hỏi kinh nghiệm → Present Perfect: Have you ever worked?
items.explanation_short: ever = kinh nghiệm → Have you ever + V3.
items.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 1: Have you ever used/tried/visited...?

items.stem: He has been a software developer ___ ten years.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ ten years = khoảng thời gian → for
items.feedback_wrong: ten years = khoảng thời gian → for.
items.explanation_short: ten years = khoảng thời gian → for.
items.ielts_tip: for + khoảng: for 3 months, for a decade.

items.stem: The company has ___ new offices in three cities.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 has + V3 → has opened
items.feedback_wrong: Sau has phải là V3: opened.
items.explanation_short: has + V3: open → opened.
items.ielts_tip: has/have + V3. Quy tắc: thêm -ed. Bất quy tắc: phải nhớ.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Have you finished the report already?'
options: Đúng: already dùng được trong câu hỏi khi ngạc nhiên
items.correct_answer: Đúng: already dùng được trong câu hỏi khi ngạc nhiên
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 already trong câu hỏi = ngạc nhiên!
items.feedback_wrong: already trong câu hỏi = surprise. Câu này ĐÚNG.
items.explanation_short: Already trong câu hỏi = ngạc nhiên.
items.ielts_tip: already trong câu hỏi = surprise. yet = neutral.

items.stem: Technology ___ rapidly this decade.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ this decade = chưa kết thúc → has advanced
items.feedback_wrong: this decade = chưa kết thúc → Present Perfect.
items.explanation_short: this decade = khoảng thời gian chưa kết thúc → Present Perfect.
items.ielts_tip: this week/month/year/decade → Present Perfect.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Build Up
ui.description: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

items.stem: The startup ___ three rounds of funding and is now planning to expand globally.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Kết quả quá khứ → hiện tại vẫn relevant → has raised
items.feedback_wrong: Kết quả quá khứ liên quan hiện tại → Present Perfect: has raised.
items.explanation_short: Kết quả quá khứ vẫn còn liên quan hiện tại → Present Perfect.
items.ielts_tip: Khi nêu kết quả dẫn đến tình trạng hiện tại → Present Perfect.

items.stem: Remote work has become increasingly popular ___ the pandemic began in 2020.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ since + sự kiện cụ thể: since the pandemic began
items.feedback_wrong: since + mốc sự kiện. Không dùng for với sự kiện.
items.explanation_short: the pandemic began = sự kiện cụ thể → since.
items.ielts_tip: since + mệnh đề/mốc. for + khoảng.

items.stem: Several multinational companies have ___ their headquarters to Southeast Asia in recent years.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 in recent years → Present Perfect: have moved
items.feedback_wrong: have + V3: moved. in recent years → Present Perfect.
items.explanation_short: have + V3: move → moved.
items.ielts_tip: in recent years/decades → Present Perfect.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The company has launched its first product in 2018.'
options: has launched → launched (in 2018 = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past)
items.correct_answer: has launched → launched (in 2018 = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past)
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 in 2018 = quá khứ cụ thể → launched (Simple Past)
items.feedback_wrong: in 2018 = thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past: launched.
items.explanation_short: in 2018 = mốc thời gian cụ thể → Simple Past.
items.ielts_tip: in + năm cụ thể → Simple Past.

items.stem: This is the most innovative product that our team ___.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ the most + ever → Present Perfect: has ever developed
items.feedback_wrong: Superlative + ever → Present Perfect.
items.explanation_short: the most + ever → Present Perfect.
items.ielts_tip: This is the best/most... I have ever + V3.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Each employee have received a new laptop for remote work.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Each = singular → has!
items.feedback_wrong: Each employee = singular → has received.
items.explanation_short: Each = singular → has received.
items.ielts_tip: Each/Every + noun + has.

items.stem: Artificial intelligence ___ nearly every industry so far.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ so far → Present Perfect: has transformed
items.feedback_wrong: so far → Present Perfect: has transformed.
items.explanation_short: so far = cho đến nay → Present Perfect.
items.ielts_tip: so far, up to now → Present Perfect.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The team hasn't completed already the final report.'
options: already → yet (phủ định dùng yet, đặt cuối câu)
items.correct_answer: already → yet (phủ định dùng yet, đặt cuối câu)
items.feedback_correct: 🎯 Phủ định → yet (cuối câu)
items.feedback_wrong: Phủ định → yet. Khẳng định → already.
items.explanation_short: Phủ định dùng yet, cuối câu.
items.ielts_tip: Khẳng định: already. Phủ định: yet. Câu hỏi: yet.

items.stem: Cloud computing ___ the way businesses operate, and it continues to evolve.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Quá khứ → vẫn liên quan hiện tại → has changed
items.feedback_wrong: Kết quả vẫn liên quan hiện tại → Present Perfect.
items.explanation_short: Kết quả quá khứ + continues to evolve → Present Perfect.
items.ielts_tip: Câu sau mô tả tình trạng hiện tại → câu trước Present Perfect.

items.stem: The number of remote workers has increased significantly ___ the last five years.
items.feedback_correct: ⚡ over the last five years = chuẩn IELTS
items.feedback_wrong: over the last/past + khoảng thời gian. Chuẩn Task 1/2.
items.explanation_short: over the last five years = cách diễn đạt chuẩn.
items.ielts_tip: Over the last decade, the number has increased...

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic

ui.title: ⚡ Speed Drill — Challenge
ui.description: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Many tech companies have relocated to Vietnam in 2023, which have created thousands of new jobs.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 in 2023 = thời điểm cụ thể → không dùng have relocated!
items.feedback_wrong: in 2023 = quá khứ cụ thể → Simple Past: relocated.
items.explanation_short: in 2023 = mốc cụ thể → Simple Past.
items.ielts_tip: Lỗi band 5.0: Present Perfect + in + năm cụ thể.

items.stem: Câu kết bài Task 2 nào CHUẨN NHẤT về ngữ pháp?
options: In conclusion, technology transformed the workplace and will continue to do so.
In conclusion, technology has transformed the workplace and will continue to do so.
In conclusion, technology had transformed the workplace and will continue to do so.
In conclusion, technology is transforming the workplace and will continue to do so.
items.correct_answer: In conclusion, technology has transformed the workplace and will continue to do so.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 has transformed + will continue = quá khứ→hiện tại→tương lai!
items.feedback_wrong: has transformed (vẫn relevant) + will continue = chuẩn nhất.
items.explanation_short: has transformed = kết quả vẫn relevant + will continue.
items.ielts_tip: Câu kết Task 2: has + V3 + and will continue...

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The IT department have been upgrading the system since three weeks, and it still hasn't been completed.'
options: The IT department have been upgrading
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 three weeks = khoảng thời gian → for, không phải since!
items.feedback_wrong: three weeks = khoảng → for three weeks.
items.explanation_short: three weeks = khoảng thời gian → for.
items.ielts_tip: since + mốc. for + khoảng.

items.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT cho IELTS Writing Task 2:
options: Many developing countries already adopted renewable energy technologies.
Many developing countries have already adopted renewable energy technologies.
Many developing countries have already adopt renewable energy technologies.
Many developing countries has already adopted renewable energy technologies.
items.correct_answer: Many developing countries have already adopted renewable energy technologies.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 have already adopted = chuẩn Present Perfect!
items.feedback_wrong: Many countries = plural → have. already giữa have và V3.
items.explanation_short: Many countries = plural → have + already + V3.
items.ielts_tip: Many countries have already + V3...

items.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN cho IELTS Writing?
'Researchers have ___ [A] that automation ___ [B] millions of jobs worldwide.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 shown (V3) + has affected (singular) = hoàn hảo!
items.feedback_wrong: show → shown (V3). automation → has.
items.explanation_short: have + shown (V3). automation = singular → has affected.
items.ielts_tip: Researchers have shown/demonstrated/found that...

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Since smartphones have become affordable, people communicated more efficiently than ever before.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Since + have become → mệnh đề chính: have communicated!
items.feedback_wrong: Since + Present Perfect → mệnh đề chính cũng Present Perfect.
items.explanation_short: Since + Present Perfect → mệnh đề chính cũng Present Perfect.
items.ielts_tip: Since + S + V, S + have/has + V3.

items.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Over the past decade, digital technology reshaped the global workforce significantly.
Over the past decade, digital technology has reshaped the global workforce significantly.
Over the past decade, digital technology reshapes the global workforce significantly.
Over the past decade, digital technology had reshaped the global workforce significantly.
items.correct_answer: Over the past decade, digital technology has reshaped the global workforce significantly.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Over the past decade + has reshaped = chuẩn Task 2!
items.feedback_wrong: Over the past decade → Present Perfect: has reshaped.
items.explanation_short: Over the past decade = chưa kết thúc → Present Perfect.
items.ielts_tip: Over the past/last + period → Present Perfect.

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The number of employees who has completed the training program have increased by 40% this quarter.'
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 who = employees (plural) → who have completed!
items.feedback_wrong: who thay cho employees (plural) → who have completed.
items.explanation_short: who = employees (plural) → have completed.
items.ielts_tip: who thay cho danh từ số nhiều → who have.

items.stem: Chọn cặp câu ĐÚNG NHẤT về ngữ pháp trong body paragraph Task 2:
options: Several companies adopted AI last year. This trend continued to grow.
Several companies have adopted AI in recent years. This trend has continued to grow.
Several companies adopted AI in recent years. This trend continued to grow.
Several companies have adopted AI last year. This trend has continued to grow.
items.correct_answer: Several companies have adopted AI in recent years. This trend has continued to grow.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 in recent years + has continued = nhất quán Present Perfect!
items.feedback_wrong: in recent years → Present Perfect. last year → Simple Past.
items.explanation_short: in recent years → Present Perfect xuyên suốt.
items.ielts_tip: in recent years/decades → Present Perfect xuyên suốt đoạn văn.

items.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'The government have [A] took significant steps to promote digital literacy, which [B] has lead to a noticeable improvement in [C] workforce productivity.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] has taken | [B] has led | [C] đúng!
items.feedback_wrong: [A] government → has + taken (V3). [B] lead → led (V3). [C] đúng.
items.explanation_short: [A] have took → has taken. [B] has lead → has led.
items.ielts_tip: V3 hay sai: take→taken, lead→led, give→given.

weak_topic_detection.logic: sai ≥2 câu cùng error_tag → weak topic
